maria (AE): folks — running preflight with Acadia Health for the Argosy-24B POC. customer wants to test two variants: argosy-24b (fp16) and argosy-24b-quant (4-bit). can we confirm catalog compatibility and any perf/cost delta?
elaine (SE): for catalog fit: model architecture is transformer decoder-only, vocab bpe-compatible. should be fine. main questions: tokenizer mapping, kv cache behaviour across quant variants, and whether we have a verified latency profile for 4-bit on our Dedicated fleet.
raj (ML Eng): quick notes: 24B is within our runtime support. quant variant will need kernel path that avoids fp16 matmuls; slight perf uplift but also lower memory. expect ~1.5-2x throughput on same GPU for throughput-bound workloads, latency similar for short seqs. need to validate KV cache correctness — some quantized checkpoints have modified KV layout.
tim (Infra Eng): infra constraints: Dedicated pool with A100s is ideal. if they want Dedicated burst + fallback to hosted, we should ensure model is replicated in hosted catalog (we can serve quant there but may be slower). what's the expected peak rps during the POC?
maria (AE): target 20 rps peak, avg 6 rps, 800 token avg per request. they asked about cost guidance vs our standard 24B hosted tier.
elaine (SE): rough cost delta: argosy-24b hosted ~= $0.45 / 1k tokens. quant variant ~= $0.28 / 1k tokens (est). Dedicated pricing depends on reserved capacity; I'll pull numbers from pricing sheet.
raj (ML Eng): also flag: long context 800 tokens -> KV cache used heavily. quant variant must preserve KV float cast on load. I can run a compatibility test using the checkpoint they provided. can someone share the s3 path?
maria (AE): uploaded to s3://acadia-poc/argosy/argosy-24b-quant-2026-03-15.tar.gz — @tim fyi for infra access.
tim (Infra Eng): I have access. I'll spin up a sandbox Dedicated pool and run a smoke deploy. expecting ~30m to get a canary up. deploy-bot: deploy job queued for sandbox-dedicated-argosy-24b at 1769005600.
deploy-bot: Job started: canary deploy on sandbox-dedicated-argosy-24b. logs: https://redwood.internal/logs/1769005600
raj (ML Eng): running validation script now:```
# validation
python tools/validate_kv.py --checkpoint s3://acadia-poc/argosy/argosy-24b-quant-2026-03-15.tar.gz --expect-length 2048
```
raj (ML Eng): initial run: tokenization mapping OK, KV shapes match runtime expectations, small numerical drift (0.2% on softmax outputs) — within tolerance for the POC.
olivia (Sec Ops): security checklist: they'll need an SCC questionnaire answered + clarify data residency. Acadia requires HIPAA SOC2 + VPC-only for PHI. we need to document whether the POC will handle PHI — if yes, must run Private deployment.
maria (AE): they're okay to de-identify for POC but might need PHI in later stage. we should mark this as enterprise blocker for Private.
elaine (SE): action items: (1) confirm quant correctness (raj) — due EOD; (2) pricing estimate for Dedicated + fallback hosted (maria/finance) — due tomorrow; (3) security questionnaire draft (olivia) — due tomorrow morning; (4) deploy canary and perf profile (tim/raj) — results in 2h.
raj (ML Eng): can run perf benchmark: will test lat P50/P95 for seq lengths [64, 256, 800], batch sizes [1,4,8]. output will include throughput and memory.
tim (Infra Eng): also test autoscale warmup config. recommend `min_nodes=2` for their traffic pattern to avoid cold-start P95 spikes.
elaine (SE): linking internal runbook for variant onboarding: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/variant-onboard. includes checklist for tokenizer, kv, quant, and rollout policy.
olivia (Sec Ops): I'll attach a short answer doc for the SCC: "Private deployment available; KMS/HSM integrated; audit logs retained 90 days by default; HIPAA support in Private with BAAs." I'll add this to the thread.
maria (AE): thanks — pinging Acadia: @Acadia_POC contact: jennifer.k — will share timeline.
raj (ML Eng): preliminary perf numbers (canary): seq=64 -> p50 42ms, p95 120ms; seq=256 -> p50 120ms, p95 340ms; seq=800 -> p50 380ms, p95 980ms. quant variant slightly faster (~15% avg). memory reduced ~30%.
eaine (SE): typo — meant elaine. :sweat_smile:
elaine (SE): noted results. Maria: want me to draft recommended rollout: start POC on quant variant in Dedicated sandbox, enable KV cache, set canary 10% then 100% after 24h smoke. if they need PHI later, migrate to Private with same config.
maria (AE): yes please. also need a short pricing note for the AE deck: include hosted vs dedicated vs private with per-token and reserve commit examples.
tim (Infra Eng): I'll attach canary logs and autoscale config. example autoscale snippet we used:```
scale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  target_rps_per_replica: 5
```
olivia (Sec Ops): added SCC answers and a pointer to our BAA template.
maria (AE): perfect — I'll synthesize and send to Acadia by EOD PST. any final blockers?
raj (ML Eng): one more: quant variant needs a small post-processing cast in runtime for numerical stability on large contexts. I'll submit a tiny runtime patch and test. should be non-disruptive.
elaine (SE): OK. tagging this as `POC-blocker: model-compat` until raj confirms patch. will update thread. :thumbsup:
__notes: Generated Slack thread JSON for sales POC coordination, matches agents.md schema: channel, thread_ts, first_message_ts, last_message_ts, participants, content. No title field. All values are strings or list of strings.
